name: Vijayalakshmi K
summary:
Results-driven Production & Application Support Engineer with experience in application monitoring,
incident management, troubleshooting, and system maintenance. Seeking to leverage technical expertise
in ensuring high application availability, minimizing downtime, and delivering reliable support services
while contributing to organizational growth and operational excellence

Provided production support and application maintenance for critical Citibank
Treasury Regulatory
Reporting systems, supporting regulatory compliance and reporting obligations
for the Hong Kong
Monetary Authority (HKMA).
Supported enterprise
applications and middleware platforms across Linux/UNIX environments,
utilizing Shell
Scripting, SQL, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Talend, BMC Remedy, AutoSys, UDeploy, Control
Center, Control
Room, and ITRS Geneos.
Managed end-to-end
incident, problem, and change management activities across Pre-Production
and Production
environments using ServiceNow, ensuring SLA compliance and operational
excellence.
Developed and
maintained UNIX shell scripts and SQL queries to automate operational processes,
improve reporting
efficiency, and support application troubleshooting activities.
Executed application
deployment and release management activities, including server restarts,
service shutdown/startup
procedures, JDBC configuration updates, token generation, and
environment validation.
Administered
and monitored enterprise batch scheduling processes using AutoSys, ensuring
successful execution
of critical business workflows and regulatory reporting jobs.
Created, maintained,
and deployed AutoSys JIL (Job Information Language) configurations, validating
scheduling dependencies
and job execution across multiple environments.
Performed production
monitoring, job failure analysis, recovery activities, and root cause
investigations
to minimize business impact and improve application availability.
Collaborated
with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams to troubleshoot
complex production
issues and deliver timely resolutions.
Conducted code
and deployment reviews to ensure adherence to organizational standards, security
requirements,
and client governance guidelines.
Supported enterprise
integration solutions involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, Talend, and Data
Warehousing
platforms, ensuring seamless data flow across business applications.
Leveraged monitoring
tools such as ITRS Geneos to proactively identify performance bottlenecks,
system anomalies,
and operational risks before impacting business services.
Gained strong
domain expertise in Banking, Treasury Operations, Regulatory Reporting, Financial
Compliance, and
Robotic Process Automation (RPA).
